promises.claim: A night is what moves energy, sleep debt and condition most.
A meal, a shower, a workout and an hour unwinding each move the measures they name, and the menu says by how much.
Readiness sets how much a class or a lab builds that day.
A night on stage is judged with your readiness at curtain time: under ${EVALUATION.sufficientReadiness}, coming in tired costs you.
Under ${ESTIMATE.sickBelow} condition, calling in sick is excused.
Long-term conditions are kept up or let go on Papers, and your own page says which.
A night moves energy, stress, sleep debt, condition and morale by the time you wake.
A commitment during the night goes ahead without you, and it counts as missed.
Commitments you slept through are named in a notice the next morning.
Classes and calls you sleep through are absences the faculty weigh at the end of the term.
Skipping ahead through the night sleeps for you, but it’s a poorer night that stops at ${COASTING_ENERGY_CEILING} energy.
Each line moves the measures it names, and readiness with them.
Work Out checks the weather as its hour ends to decide whether it was a run.
A meal is paid the way How You Pay pays the day’s spending: the debit card, the credit card or cash.
The fitness a workout builds is your Stamina on the Player Profile.
An injury from a run or a workout needs care, and you may owe a share of its cost.
A commitment only arrives as the clock moves, and Play opens with the chapter after this one.
Every move of the clock, Advance and Choose An Event among them, stops here at each commitment.
The plans you put on the calendar yourself are the commitments Skip It works on.
Classes, calls and shifts you went to or missed are counted at the end of each term’s classes.
Calling in sick before a school day begins excuses the commitments you’d otherwise miss.
A rehearsal with a classmate stops the clock like any commitment, and its dialog offers Call It Off, at a cost to their trust.
The live clock stops and pauses at each commitment on the calendar, and asks.
Every second the clock runs is charged to your energy, food and the rest of your wellbeing as waking time, as it passes.
For hours you don’t want to wait through, Advance jumps them.
A live clock keeps you up past midnight; Sleep is how the night gets slept.
Every jump stops at each commitment on the way, and the stop’s dialog asks whether you go.
A jump of more than an hour through the night sleeps your character from midnight, a night that stops at ${COASTING_ENERGY_CEILING} energy.
Each midnight crossed buys the day’s groceries and tops up nourishment and hygiene.
The hours you’d rather live than skip, the live clock runs one to one.
Your return’s question carries File It, which files the year’s return as Papers would.
When your US status is ending, its question carries Apply For OPT while that can still be applied for.
Before a long-untouched account goes to the state, the bank’s question carries Keep The Account.
A Sleep that ran over commitments leaves a notice naming each one it slept through.
Go There takes you to the screen a notice or a question is about.
A plan is a commitment: when the clock reaches it, the clock stops and asks Go or Skip It.
The Sleep dialog lists a plan inside its hours as one you’d sleep through, and sleeping through misses it.
A plan about to begin refuses anything in Look After Yourself that would run into it.
An hour of practice that would run into a plan is refused until the plan has passed.
Skipping a plan, or sleeping through one, leaves a notice in What Needs You.
A plan’s hours open onto the sky over each of them.
Work Out checks the weather as it ends: dry and mild, it was a run, building more fitness and burning more.
The weather is the same town’s, beside its time, season and daylight on Home.
The flu comes in your town’s climate’s weeks for it, and a day with the flu is one to call in sick.
